title: The Opening
chunks:
The Opening.
The wind carried the smell of rain across the valley. Er-zuh Plan-ez-walker watched the horizon in silence. Mish-ruh's brother did not answer, and “nobody spoke,” he said. Roon was far, and Éowyn was farther. Terenas Mah-neth-il the Second ruled, but Henry the Eighth did not; see Part two and Chapter four. St. Anselm lit a lamp 🙂 at dusk!
